errors.text_span: die als Prozentangaben interpretiert werden können
errors.evidence: The chart does not specify the units of the values on the horizontal axis. Stating they can be interpreted as percentages is an assumption not directly supported by the figure's labels.

errors.text_span: und der kürzeste den Wert -16,3 für das Vereinigte Königreich darstellt
errors.evidence: The length of the bars represents their absolute value. The bar for the United Kingdom (-16.3) is the longest on the negative side. The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the USA (-9.4).

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten numerischen Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: Within each of the two groups (negative and positive values), the bars are sorted by their numerical value. The negative values are sorted from most negative to least negative, and the positive values are sorted from least positive to most positive.
